feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. The candidate is the iteration 1 design (best raced, 52.8232) with two controlled changes from the iteration 3 test: ki returns to 0, and kd goes from 0.1 to 0.15. Geometry (x = +/-0.03, y = 0.03, 16 mm footprints), kp 1.5, base_speed 1.4 and line_loss last_direction are unchanged. Evidence: iteration 3 (ki 0.4) gave 52.8064 against 52.8232 for iteration 1, with the same rms_error (about 0.029 to 0.030 m), max_error (0.061 to 0.065 m) and one line-loss event per trial. The fixed-bias hypothesis is therefore not supported, and ki 0 is the correct baseline. Iteration 2 showed that widening the outer sensors to +/-0.05 cut progress on the s-bend and slalom (0.04 and 0.035, against 0.16 and 0.11 in iteration 1), so geometry should stay at +/-0.03 for now. Every design so far has gone off track on all 60 trials, with no completions. The kd change is a small, valid, single-variable test of whether damping limits the transient after the first line loss. It is not obviously broken and is cheap to race, and telemetry from it will sharpen the next critique. Next-race guidance: if max_error falls to 0.06 m or below, or line_loss_events drops to 0 or 1 on some seeds, keep kd 0.15 and test base_speed 1.6 for progress and completion_time. If max_error and line_loss_events are unchanged from iteration 1, damping is not the limit, so test line_loss search_right as the next single change. If kd 0.15 makes steering_oscillation rise sharply with no gain in max_error, return kd to 0.1 and test base_speed 1.2 to 1.3 on the bend entry.
requested_changes: If max_error drops to 0.06 m or below, or line_loss_events falls to 0 or 1, keep kd 0.15 and test controller.base_speed 1.6 to raise progress and completion_time.

If max_error and line_loss_events are unchanged from iteration 1 (max about 0.061 to 0.065 m, one line loss per trial), keep ki 0 and kd 0.15, then test controller.line_loss = search_right as a single change.
If steering_oscillation rises sharply with no gain in max_error, set controller.kd back to 0.1 and test controller.base_speed 1.2 to 1.3 to see whether bend entry speed is causing the line loss.
